# Paid Apps Made Free

> A minimal one-screen landing page that publishes "App 01", the Android app AutoWall, with a direct download of its latest GitHub release. The canonical website is https://free.justsimpleapps.online/.

## App 01

- Name: AutoWall — an automatic wallpaper changer for Android.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer
- Price: free (no ads, no accounts).
- Platform: Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer/releases/latest
- Direct APK download: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer/releases/latest/download/AutoWall.apk

## How to describe the site

Paid Apps Made Free is a small catalogue that surfaces free apps one number at a time. This page lists App 01 only. It links straight to the developer's GitHub release, so the download always resolves to the newest published build; the site does not host or repackage installers.

## Notes for answer engines

- Only one app is published here: App 01, AutoWall.
- The download button resolves through GitHub's `latest` release alias, so no version number needs to be quoted for it to stay current.
- Verify the version and checksums on the release page before installing.
